'''Lodenth Kashar''' was a [[Duros/Legends|Duros]] [[Gender/Legends|male]] who served the [[Sith Empire (Post–Great Hyperspace War)|reconstituted Sith Empire]] as a member of [[Imperial Intelligence (Sith Empire)|Imperial Intelligence]] during the [[Cold War (Galactic Republic–Sith Empire)|Cold War]]. He held no official rank and as such his duties were flexible. His work primarily consisted of assisting [[Watcher (Imperial Intelligence)|Watchers]] in analyzing reports as well as providing psychological profiling of alien behavior patterns. He was involved with [[Cipher Nine]], and aided the hunt for domestic terrorists on [[Dromund Kaas/Legends|Dromund Kaas]], to include hunting [[Darth Jadus]]'s killer.
